lines.text: Students often walk to the library only to find the book is already issued. This app lets them reserve books online.
- Students shall log in with their university email and password.
- The system shall lock an account after 3 failed login attempts.
- Librarians must be able to add, edit and remove books from the catalogue.
- A student shall reserve at most 3 books at the same time.
- A reserved book shall be held for 24 hours before the reservation expires.
- A student may reserve up to 5 books at one time during exam weeks.
- The system should send an email reminder 2 days before the due date.
- A reserved book shall be held for 48 hours if the student is a final-year student.
- Search results shall appear within 2 seconds for 500 users at the same time.
- The app should be easy to use and look modern.
- The system must store all data on university servers only.
- The app shall be available 99% of the time during library hours.
